query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count!"
            FROM rooms r
            LEFT JOIN room_summaries rs ON rs.room_id = r.room_id
            WHERE r.is_public = TRUE
              AND (r.name ILIKE $1
                   OR r.topic ILIKE $1
                   OR r.canonical_alias ILIKE $1)
              AND ($2::text[] IS NULL
                   OR rs.room_type = ANY($2)
                   OR ($3::boolean AND rs.room_type IS NULL))
